sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 % [llm113846]
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer regarding pump housing ph-100, and for the care your team clearly puts into this part. We genuinely appreciate what a family-run foundry brings, and we respect the skill and dedication behind your work, as well as the cost pressures you describe.

On price, though, we must hold our position: the foundry wants +8.8 %. We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price. Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best. We commit to a binding volume of 4,000 pcs per year over 24 months.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part? We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We value our long-standing relationship and appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract with a volume of 4,000 pieces per year.
Building on this volume and maintaining the 30-day payment period, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.30 per unit.
Please provide the detailed delivery figures for this volume so we can firmly allocate the necessary capacity in our foundry.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 % [llm113846]
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your revised offer on pump housing ph-100, and for your willingness to reserve foundry capacity for us. We appreciate your openness about your cost drivers and fully respect that those figures stay with you.

To be direct: the foundry wants +8.8 %. We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price. Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.

On volume, we commit to a binding 4,000 pcs per year over 24 months, so you can plan your capacity with confidence. We value our cooperation and look forward to your decision.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We acknowledge your binding commitment to 4,000 pieces per year over 24 months, which provides the necessary planning security for our foundry.
In recognition of your improved offer and the 30-day payment term, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.60 per unit.
We suggest a brief meeting to finalize the remaining details of this agreement.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
